content:
Squaring the recurrence gives
\[
a_{k+1}^2=a_k^2+2+\frac1{a_k^2}.
\]
Summing for \(k=1,\dots,99\):
\[
a_{100}^2=a_1^2+2\cdot 99+\sum_{k=1}^{99}\frac1{a_k^2}
=199+\sum_{k=1}^{99}\frac1{a_k^2}.
\]
Also, from the squared recurrence, \(a_k^2\ge 2k-1\), so
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{99}\frac1{a_k^2}\le \sum_{k=1}^{99}\frac1{2k-1}\le \sum_{k=1}^{99}\frac1k<1+\ln 99<6.
\]
Thus
\[
199<a_{100}^2<205,
\]
so
\[
14<a_{100}<15.
\]
Therefore the integer part of \(a_{100}\) is \(\boxed{14}\).
